title: A Radio Segment on Funny Travel Mishaps
script: Radio Host: [warmly] Good morning, listeners! Today we're collecting your funniest travel mishap stories. We have a caller on the line. Hello!
Caller: Hello! I have a good one, actually, from a trip a few years ago.
Radio Host: [thoughtful] Perfect, please share it with us.
Caller: I arrived at my hotel late at night, after a very long flight, completely exhausted.
Radio Host: [honestly] What happened when you got there?
Caller: I gave my name at the desk, and the clerk said there was no reservation under it at all.
Radio Host: [carefully] Oh no! What did you do?
Caller: I checked my email, and realized I had booked a hotel with almost the exact same name, in a different city entirely.
Radio Host: [curious] You booked the wrong hotel completely? That's incredible.
Caller: Completely wrong city! I was two hours away from where I actually needed to sleep that night.
Radio Host: [relieved] So what happened next? Where did you end up staying?
Caller: The kind clerk actually called around and found me a room in a nearby guesthouse for the night.
Radio Host: [reflective] That was lucky. Did you eventually make it to the correct hotel?
Caller: The next morning, yes. I took an early train and arrived just as they were serving breakfast.
Radio Host: [encouraging] Did the correct hotel charge you for missing the first night?
Caller: No, luckily they were understanding once I explained the whole confusing story.
Radio Host: What did you learn from that whole experience?
Caller: [warmly] Now I always double-check the city name, not just the hotel name, before I click confirm.
Radio Host: That's excellent advice for all our listeners planning trips this year.
Caller: Definitely. Check twice, laugh later, that's my new travel motto.
